parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: The rotation blade is the sharp cutting component of the knife, made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It performs the cutting action and can rotate or fold into the handle for safety and portability.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot joint to open or close, allowing the knife to switch between active and stored states.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the handle of the knife, typically made of durable plastic for a comfortable and secure grip.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the pivot mechanism for the blade, ensuring safe handling during use.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the blade rotates; it may include a locking mechanism to secure the blade in position.
